item.content:encoded:
News / TradingView / Key facts: TSMC (2330) Q3 revenue NT$1.49T record; 2026 capex $60–64B

Key facts: TSMC (2330) Q3 revenue NT$1.49T record; 2026 capex $60–64B Vortex Media Less than 1 min read

2330 TSMC (2330) posted Q3 revenue NT$1.49T (~$46.7B), ~50% YoY, above prior guidance. Management guided Q3 gross margin 65–67% and operating margin 56–58%. Q3 results call at 06:00 GMT.

3 sources Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. Sponsored ADR (2330) reported third-quarter revenue that rose 50% year over year, reaching a new quarterly record and surpassing market expectations. Reuters TSMC (2330) raised 2026 capex to $60–64B; analysts model ~$63B for 2026 and up to ~$83B for 2027. Company plans ~$265B investment in Arizona fabs and weighing Texas projects.

3 sources Traders watch Taiwan Semiconductor (2330): focus on Nvidia AI accelerator demand, 2nm process and CoWoS packaging ramp, capacity expansion and short-term cost pressure until utilization improves. Invezz TSMC ADR (2330): Options implied a ~4% post‑earnings move, heavy activity in $450 calls and $440 puts (range ~$427–$463). Banks raised targets and revised 2026 growth forecasts.
